name: Tominator T-71
description: Reacts to signed public events with a learned magnitude estimate (same free-direction, learned-magnitude shape as stock-market/tominator-t70), confirmed/dampened by short-term trend; fades deviations from a longer trailing average on the many rounds with no event, always sized cash-only since that's a heuristic bet, not real information. Goes short on a negative event when margin is enabled, discounted by an estimated borrow-cost carry. Never averages down, runs a self-imposed buying-power safety margin, and backs both with a portfolio-level stop-loss and a proactive margin-call de-risk.
